newsitem.title: USA: Tambrands awards $65 mln Tampax ad campaign.
newsitem.headline: Tambrands awards $65 mln Tampax ad campaign.

text.p: Tambrands Inc said Monday it has appointed Foote, Cone & Belding (FCB) as its global advertising agency for Tampax.
Tambrands said it expects annual advertising spending of about $65 million.
Tambrands said FCB, a unit of True North Communications Inc, will handle creative development for the Tampax brand worldwide, including Tambrands' new product initiatives.
A Tambrands spokeswoman said the New York firm of BBDO had the contract for the last five years. BBDO was one of three agencies that vied for the new contract, the spokeswoman said.

A statement from Tambrands said Foote, Cone & Belding developed a global campaign idea aimed at all women, whether they are lifelong tampon users in America or new to the product category in Asia and Latin America.
The company said this is crucial to its goal of growing the tampon category and the Tampax brand around the world.
